# Version 4.147.0
> **Previewing Skia m147** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.147.0-preview)

> **Superseded by [4.148.0](4.148.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 4.148.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.147.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.6/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.147 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and expanded platform support. The v4 preview line adds color font palettes, configurable surface sampling, zero-copy stream access, and new Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. It also fixes Android typeface initialization, Android GL view reattachment, and an SKPath finalizer crash.

## Breaking Changes

- **Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed** — The Skia m147 update drops the EOL Tizen arm and x86 native builds. Move Tizen deployments to the new `tizen-arm64` or `tizen-x64` assets before upgrading. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **WASM native assets now require .NET 8 or later** — Native assets for Emscripten versions older than 3.1.34 are removed. Blazor WASM and Uno Platform WASM projects targeting .NET 6 or .NET 7 now receive a build error; retarget them to .NET 8 or later. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo renamed to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo** — The Vulkan YCbCr conversion info struct now follows the SkiaSharp `GR` casing convention. Update references to `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`; the old type no longer provides its IEquatable, Equals, or equality operators. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **SKStream.Move rejects offsets outside the 32-bit native range** — The legacy `SKStream.Move(long)` overload now uses a checked conversion and throws `OverflowException` instead of silently truncating large offsets. Keep offsets within the 32-bit range and migrate away from the obsolete overload. ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))
- **Assembly version advances to 4.x** — SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.147.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any hard-coded assembly-version checks when adopting the v4 preview. ([#3640](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3640), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))

## Engine

- **Skia advances from m119 to m147** — The bundled engine spans the m132 and m133 updates through m147, bringing codec orientation, HDR and wide-gamut improvements, CICP color spaces, newer filters, and accumulated rendering fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp can query variation axes, clone typefaces at design coordinates, select built-in palettes, and override individual palette colors. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))

## API Surface

- **Animated WebP encoding** — `SKWebpEncoder` adds single-frame and animated encoding overloads, with frame durations represented by `SKWebpEncoderFrame`. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Sampling control for surface draws** — `SKSurface.Draw` and `SKCanvas.DrawSurface` gain `SKSamplingOptions` overloads for choosing filtering and mipmap behavior. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Zero-copy access to memory-backed stream data** — `SKStream.GetData()` returns the backing `SKData` when the native stream can expose it cheaply. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **New document, GPU, mask filter, and color APIs** — Adds `SKDocument.CreateXps`, per-resource `GRContext.Flush`, `SKMaskFilter.CreateShader`, `SKColorSpace.CreateCicp`, HDR color types, and the correctly ordered `HBColor` value type. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560))

## Bug Fixes

- **Typeface defaults initialize reliably** — Default typeface resolution moves to the managed font-manager path, avoiding Android API 36 startup crashes and returning an empty typeface as a safe last resort. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))
- **SKPath finalization no longer races its builder** — Disposal no longer flushes a collected `SKPathBuilder`, preventing a finalizer-thread native crash. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Android SKGLView survives navigation and tab switches** — Reattached GL views retain their current dimensions instead of recreating a zero-sized surface. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **Font and stream edge cases corrected** — Undersized variable-font spans now follow their documented write counts, glyph checks avoid infinite recursion, and negative stream moves retain the correct native value. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic assets for x64 and arm64** — Dedicated `linux-bionic` runtime assets support Android-hosted Linux environments for both SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen gains 64-bit native assets** — Adds official `tizen-x64` and `tizen-arm64` package assets while the Skia m147 transition retires 32-bit Tizen builds. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Apple libraries target the base 26.0 SDK** — Versioned library TFMs use 26.0 for broader Xcode 26 compatibility, while apps use unversioned Apple TFMs. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6

HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, introduces `HBColor` for correct `hb_color_t` channel ordering, and gains Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges), [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#3752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3752), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))

## Preview 3 (May 24, 2026)

Requires .NET 8 or later for WASM native assets and renames `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` to `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`. Adds `HBColor`, XPS creation, per-resource GPU flushes, shader mask filters, refreshes bundled native libraries, and prevents NanoServer font-manager crashes. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3835))

## Preview 1 (April 28, 2026)

Moves the assembly to v4 and Skia to m147, removes 32-bit Tizen assets, and makes oversized `SKStream.Move` offsets fail explicitly. Adds variable fonts, color font palettes, configurable surface sampling, CICP color spaces, Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets, while fixing Android default typefaces and SKGLView reattachment.
